method: Visual inspection of six contact sheets containing 90 samples from the final encoded MP4, plus full-resolution critical frames; full-file decode and audio/cadence checks are recorded separately. This is sampled visual QA, not a claim of a human real-time viewing/listening session.
observations: Chapter titles and subtitle band remain legible and separate from the controls.
Cursor and click feedback are present in actual source footage; operation results are visible.
Opening and closing use authentic Pointly and Bycode assets.
Contextual zooms preserve the active fields; supplementary responsive guide fills its intended frame.
Reviewed cuts remove repeated sign-in/loading passages and retain genuine failed/retried operations.
Scene 20 holds the actual insufficient-points message; scene 22 shows the actual public archived-account card with retained points and reactivation guidance.
Final samples contain UI content; no damaged or fully black intervals were found in the complete decode.
limits: Printing remains partially validated in qa/print-verification.json.
Browser source cadence is measured VFR; final export is 60 FPS CFR. Reading holds are intentional.
Audio was checked through local independent acoustic transcription, hashes, clipping/silence and loudness analysis; no human listening session is claimed.
brandStatus: draft, existing authentic assets and shared product profile preserved
